scope: development tooling: require live spare capacity before transient fallback reassignment

source.delivery_head_binding: The governed handoff freezes the PR head containing this manifest; implementation_commit is its source ancestor.

problem.summary: Double-audited source and controlled runtime evidence showed that optional transient load balancing (assignment_transiently_blocked_recoverable and reconcile_unavailable_assignments) evaluated fallback readiness via agent_can_take_task only, which verifies endpoint/account health and configured capacity > 0 without checking current active worker load against max_parallel. As a result, a task whose owner had a transiently blocked condition (such as an expired health probe) could be reassigned to a healthy fallback candidate that was already running at max_parallel, falsely claiming in the status message that the candidate 'had spare capacity'. In addition, reconcile_unavailable_assignments lacked a live capacity revalidation immediately before the governed reassignment write, meaning a candidate whose capacity became exhausted or whose observation expired between candidate planning and the commit write would still receive the reassignment write.

fix.candidate_spare_capacity_requirement: assignment_transiently_blocked_recoverable now requires that candidate_load < candidate_capacity (according to the canonical active-load model agent_dispatch_loads) in addition to agent_can_take_task readiness. Fallback candidates at max_parallel are ineligible.
fix.headroom_candidate_filtering: reconcile_unavailable_assignments now filters load_balance_owner_candidates to only candidates with live spare capacity (candidate_capacity > candidate_load) sorted by headroom descending.
fix.commit_time_revalidation: Immediately before invoking persist_task_reassignment, reconcile_unavailable_assignments revalidates that the selected fallback has owner_capacity > 0, current_owner_load (including tasks assigned in the current cycle) < owner_capacity, and agent_can_take_task(config, new_owner, task, state=state) remains satisfied. If full or observation is no longer current, it cleanly aborts as a no-op with no partial write, worker launch, or false log.
fix.message_truthfulness: The status message claim that the fallback 'had spare capacity' is now truthful and backed by the commit-time capacity predicate.
fix.cycle_load_tracking: agent_loads is updated upon successful reassignment to account for newly assigned tasks in subsequent evaluations within the same cycle.

before_after_behavior_map.scenario: Incumbent owner probe expired; fallback candidate is healthy but already running at max_parallel.
before_after_behavior_map.before: assignment_transiently_blocked_recoverable returned 'owner_transiently_blocked', load_balance_owner_candidates included the full candidate, and reconcile_unavailable_assignments committed the reassignment with a false status message claiming the fallback had spare capacity.
before_after_behavior_map.after: assignment_transiently_blocked_recoverable requires live spare capacity and returns None for a candidate at max_parallel; load_balance_watch drops the task; no reassignment or false log occurs.

before_after_behavior_map.scenario: Fallback candidate has spare capacity during hold, but becomes full before the final write.
before_after_behavior_map.before: reconcile_unavailable_assignments proceeded blindly to persist_task_reassignment without commit-time revalidation, assigning the task despite zero headroom.
before_after_behavior_map.after: Commit-time revalidation immediately before persist_task_reassignment detects current_owner_load >= owner_capacity, skips the write, launches no worker, and records no false log.

before_after_behavior_map.scenario: Fallback candidate has spare capacity during hold, but health probe expires before the final write.
before_after_behavior_map.before: reconcile_unavailable_assignments wrote the reassignment to an unready/expired fallback.
before_after_behavior_map.after: Commit-time revalidation evaluates agent_can_take_task against current state, detects unready/expired observation, and skips the write.

before_after_behavior_map.scenario: Incumbent owner probe expired; fallback candidate is healthy and idle (or below max_parallel) after hold duration.
before_after_behavior_map.after: Reassigned to fallback with truthful status message claiming spare capacity proved by the commit-time predicate. Ordinary planner redispatches normally; no worker is launched directly by the recovery lane.

reproductions.name: repro_1_full_fallback_reassignment
reproductions.description: Owner probe is expired, fallback Codex2 is healthy but running 2 workers (max_parallel=2). Pre-fix supervisor persisted reassignment to Codex2 and claimed Codex2 had spare capacity. Post-fix supervisor detects zero headroom, returns None, and avoids reassignment.
reproductions.pre_fix_outcome: persist_task_reassignment was called with new_owner='Codex2' and message claiming 'Codex2 had spare capacity'.
reproductions.post_fix_outcome: persist_task_reassignment was not called; watch was cleared; no reassignment or false log.

reproductions.name: repro_2_capacity_change_before_final_write
reproductions.description: Owner probe is expired, fallback Codex2 is healthy and idle initially, but capacity is exhausted before the final write. Pre-fix supervisor wrote reassignment regardless. Post-fix supervisor commit-time revalidation aborted the write.
reproductions.pre_fix_outcome: persist_task_reassignment was called despite zero commit-time headroom.
reproductions.post_fix_outcome: persist_task_reassignment was not called; no worker launched; clean no-op.
